shell_commands: npm run prettier:check 2>&1 | grep -E "(accumulat|PASS|FAIL)" || echo "Checking formatting..."

git add src/orchestration/usageAccumulator.ts src/orchestration/usageAccumulator.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): sum token fields across provider rounds

Add accumulateUsage helper that sums UsageMetadata from multiple rounds,
treating undefined as identity (no usage reported in that round) so rounds
without reported usage do not poison the total.
EOF
)" && git log -1 --oneline

git commit --amend -m "$(cat <<'EOF'

Add accumulateUsage helper that sums UsageMetadata from multiple rounds,
treating undefined as identity (no usage reported in that round) so rounds
without reported usage do not poison the total.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log -1 --format=%B
git push origin HEAD && git status
